**Chinese name:** 中微半导体设备（上海）股份有限公司 (Zhōngwēi Bàndǎotǐ Shèbèi (Shànghǎi) Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded by veteran semiconductor engineer Dr. Gerald Yin (尹志尧) in May 2004 — not on the US Entity List as of the sources checked for this tracker, notable given how central etch tools are to advanced-node manufacturing. H1 2026 revenue reached ¥6.691 billion (+34.9% year-on-year) with net profit of ¥2.825 billion, up roughly 300% year-on-year; the company reported several key etch processes for advanced logic and memory devices reaching mass production during the half, and a second Lingang, Shanghai facility was reportedly being planned.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Plasma etching systems (Capacitively Coupled Plasma and Inductively Coupled Plasma, under the Primo brand) and MOCVD deposition tools used in compound semiconductor and LED manufacturing.

| **Segment** | Etch, Deposition (MOCVD) |
| **Node Capability** | Plasma etch tools (Primo CCP/ICP series) in use down to 5nm at some customers, per company statements |

## Capability Trajectory

- **2021**: Etch tools on tier-1 lines 65nm to 5nm; 12-inch etch used for key 5nm/sub-5nm steps
- **2021**: 1,500th CCP etch reaction chamber shipped; products used at 5nm and below
- **2025**: Advanced-logic MOL etch and memory ultra-high-aspect-ratio etch in volume; >6,800 etch chambers shipped
- **2025**: LPCVD cumulative shipments pass 300 chambers; RP-epi tools at customers for qualification
- **2026**: >8,800 reaction chambers in volume production on 220+ lines (all tool types)

## Manufacturing Sites in China

- **AMEC Lingang industrialisation base (phase I)** (Shanghai (Lingang New Area)) — Plasma etch and thin-film deposition tools; ~157 mu, ~180,000 m2; opened Aug 2024
- **AMEC Lingang industrialisation base (phase II, planned)** (Shanghai (Lingang New Area)) — Etch, metrology/inspection and thin-film deposition tools; RMB 3.5bn planned investment; ~RMB 3bn annual revenue at full output
- **AMEC Nanchang production and R&D base** (Nanchang) — IC and broader semiconductor equipment production (products not specified); 140,000 m2, in use from July 2023
- **AMEC Jinqiao (HQ) R&D and production base** (Shanghai (Jinqiao, Pudong)) — R&D and production (products not specified)
- **AMEC Chengdu R&D and production base (under construction)** (Chengdu (High-tech Zone)) — Thin-film deposition (CVD, ALD) equipment; phase I ~70,000 m2; production planned 2027
- **AMEC Guangzhou base (under construction)** (Guangzhou) — R&D and production (details not disclosed)
